name: regionfolder
description: Provides folding for text wrapped with #region comments in VS Code.
readme:
# #region folding for VS Code

Adds folding for `#region` / `#endregion` comment markers on top of indentation folding, for many languages.

This is the unmodified extension by maptz, pinned to a specific version and verified to work in Diode. It is not published on Open VSX, so the `.vsix` is rehosted in this registry under its MIT license.
